profiles.title: Planning essentials
profiles.when: Install before architecture-first discovery. These skills are not needed for the CLI upgrade tracks.

skills.domain-modeling: Recover domain vocabulary and record domain decisions.

skills.cost-estimation: Attempt bounded pricing and record assumptions, evidence, or concrete blockers.

profiles.title: Existing UI
profiles.when: Install when the application has a user interface. Planning uses bounded init/document discovery, not hooks, live mode, or redesign.

skills.impeccable: Recover product/design authority and preserve or intentionally change named UI surfaces.

profiles.title: Implementation support
profiles.when: Install before a separately requested rebuild slice. Our azure-app-rebuild skill controls delivery; upstream implement is deliberately excluded because it includes an automatic commit step.

skills.codebase-design: Design bounded module interfaces without replacing the selected architecture.
skills.tdd: Develop changed behavior through focused failing tests.
skills.code-review: Review implementation against repository standards and requirements.

skills.handoff: Preserve package, scope, and validation context for another session.

profiles.title: Target-specific specialists
profiles.when: Optional. Install only the named skills needed by the selected target; the command below lists the available selection and can be narrowed. Specialist installation does not authorize deployment.

skills.azure-enterprise-infra-planner: Consult on enterprise identity, network, and landing-zone constraints.
skills.entra-app-registration: Consult on application OAuth and identity.
skills.azure-kubernetes: Consult when Kubernetes has an evidenced requirement.
skills.azure-diagnostics: Investigate operational failures in an authorized environment.
